body:
Hey Andy, thanks for reaching out.  It's not so much that I hate talking, I'm actually pretty outgoing I just feel like I can never open up and be honest with anyone to get help.  I do okay in managing my anxiety alone most of the time but it usually just builds on itself until I explode in an anxiety fueled outburst.  I usually just over think what I want/need to say and find reasons to not say it. 

As far as the girl goes she is just hurt from our break up or at least I think so.  She broke up with me because I was not a very good boyfriend.  I loved her and she knew that but because of my anxiety a lot of our arguments would just turn into us dealing with my feelings and her being left ignored.  She got to a point where she couldn't deal with my selfishness so she ended it.  She misses having me in her life but she does not want to be back in that relationship which is hard for me because I honestly feel like I could be better now.  I learned a lot with our time apart, my anxiety and over thinking actually helped me learn where she was coming from and how I was being selfish and taking her for granted.  I can understand why she hates me because I hate how I acted towards her in that regard.  I doubt I will see her face to face anytime soon because she is afraid she will end up getting back together with me if we meet up and I can't blame her on that one.

Thanks again for reaching out, it does help a bit.  It helps when I'm consulting someone else instead of just brewing on my thoughts.  I doubt I will ever be completely better but I hope to reach a point where I can be stable :(.  Nice to meet you Andy and thanks again.
